create_CompressedTensorsW8A8Mxfp8MoEMeth: create a CompressedTensorsW8A8Mxfp8MoEMethod instance with an FusedMoEConfig for MXFP8 W8A8 quantized MoE layers
build_create_weights: build MoE layer weights (w13_weight, w2_weight, w13_weight_scale, w2_weight_scale) as MXFP8 parameters on a FusedMoE layer
process_weights_after_loading: process and convert loaded MoE weights to the FP8 kernel format with per-group scales and initialize the MoE kernel
run_apply_monolithic: run the monolithic MoE kernel apply with MXFP8 weights, router logits, and activation parameters
run_apply: run the non-monolithic MoE kernel apply with MXFP8 weights, topk_weights, topk_ids, and optional shared experts input
